query:
SELECT 
  b.id,
  b.title,
  b.authorId,
  b.createdAt,
  b.workflowStep
FROM books b
JOIN authors a ON b.authorId = a.id
JOIN users u ON a.userId = u.id
WHERE u.email = 'paulinet77@gmail.com'
  AND b.title = 'Be SUCKcessful'
ORDER BY b.createdAt ASC;
